values.meaning: Magic Damage to enemies hit, percent of target's maximum health
Minimum Minion Damage (damage floor vs. minions)
Capped Monster Damage (damage ceiling vs. monsters)
Armor Reduction inflicted on the Cursed target

mechanics.claim: Mourning Mist deals magic damage in a splash area at the target location, with a floor against minions and a cap against large monsters.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, down to a minimum threshold against {{tip|minions}}, and capped against {{tip|monsters}}

mechanics.claim: The Cursed mark's armor reduction is a debuff on the target that increases damage taken from all sources, not just Yorick.
mechanics.quote: The target is {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} and inflicted with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}}

mechanics.claim: The damage from a Mist Walker's leap onto a Cursed target is part of the same cast instance as Mourning Mist, not a separate on-hit instance.
mechanics.quote: The damage done by the {{as|Mist Walkers'|mist}} leap shares a {{tip|cast instance}} with ''Mourning Mist''.

mechanics.claim: Yorick and his summons gain bonus movement speed while facing a Cursed target, which does not require vision of the target; this is a movement effect, not a damage effect.
mechanics.quote: gain {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing nearby ''Cursed'' enemies

mechanics.claim: Yorick snaps his facing to the target location at the start of the cast, which does not itself change damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Yorick''' will snap his facing direction towards the target location at the start of the cast time.
